name: Stay
tagline: A calmer home for knowledge and publishing.
description: A platform for public profiles, source-backed reading, and durable publication. Built around private knowledge and an invite-only community that protects attention.

name: Digital Organism Theory
tagline: A foundational architecture of reality and experience.
description: The DOT Academy develops a foundational architecture of reality and experience through definitions, diagrams, hypotheses, criticism, and experiments. Book One remains its own fixed publication.

name: Sullix
tagline: Construction and real estate, connected by AI.
description: An AI-native platform connecting contractor discovery, project execution, payments, and compliance. Purpose-built agents support estimating, matching, risk, materials, and investment analysis.

media.title: Faro prepares a project draft
media.description: Recorded Sullix software with a fictional kitchen remodel. Scope, budget, and planning questions are prepared for contractor review.
media.transcript: Faro presents a reviewable kitchen-remodel draft with the scope of work, an $84,000 budget, and a proposed start next month. The draft remains pending until the contractor reviews and confirms it. This recording demonstrates project drafting; it does not show an autonomous project completion or a customer result.

name: Avia
description: Dispatcher and admin tools, a driver mobile app, and partner onboarding in one medical transportation platform. Tenant isolation, field-level encryption, and audit trails support secure operations.

name: Hermetic Knowledge Isolation
description: Runs LLM agent tools in short-lived, signed-domain containers with a constrained Model Context Protocol surface, so a prompt that escapes its task still cannot reach the host.
